I really am not one to complain, but when it comes to your health and wellbeing, the staff unfortunately appear to not make it a priority what so ever.
I (like a lot of people in current times) have been feeling very low. I was diagnosed with PTSD and depression, and was given continious drugs to help cure it, rather than support and therapy. This essentially made me become addicted to the anti-despressants I was taking.
The catalyst for me was when my prescriptions were messed up. The pharmacy claimed they hadn't recieved my prescription for my anti-depressants. I couldn't get through to reception, and when I finally did they told me I needed to go through Patches (their online appointment system) to speak to a doctor, to get the tablets put back onto a prescription (despite the fact I've was on these tablets for over a year - and on a high dose as well). I went onto Patches, made an appointment and heard nothing. When I rang reception they told me that the appointment had accidentally slipped through the net - accidents happen, I get that. When I rang reception again and waited for an answer the next day (it's normality to be on hold for about 30 mins before someone answers, no matter what time of day it is), I explained that no doctor has contacted me yet and could I speak to someone that day instead. I was told that there were no appointments that day either, and after explaining that it was pretty urgent and I really need to speak to someone as my mental health was getting worse due to no prescription, I was told by a reception - in quite a rude way - that there was nothing she could do, it wasn't her fault and the doctor wouldnt be seeing me today. At the time I was extremely down, and I was very honest with her about that. Was I offered anywhere else to go in the meantime? Nope. Did she say anything remotely kind or give me any advice? Nope. I asked to speak with a manager, to be told the that her supervisor wasn't there. The situation was just so unprofessional and left me even more upset in the first place. It ended up that I went a week without taking medication I've been on for over a year. I had really bad withdrawal symptoms from there (headaches, extreme dizziness, nausea etc) I'm not a doctor but I don't think that is very acceptable, and could have potentially ended in a dangerous situation.
Thankfully, I have registered with a new surgery now, who actually answer the phone and I've had appointments the SAME DAY i've rang. I've been weaned off the horrible high dose of addictive drugs and been given better help and support.

It was formerly excellent but in the last 4 years has become increasingly dysfunctional. The core medical staff remain substantially unchanged so it isn't a problem with the doctors, nurses, nor most of the medical support staff so I must assume that the problem is with the administration of the practice.

In the last two years I have failed every time but once to be able to contact them using the PATCHS system, both the app (now removed) and the online version, I have tried often to contact the practice by phone without success, only to be held at 'number one in the queue' for for over an hour, at least once for over two hours before I gave up, have twice been given inappropriate medication by an 'advanced practitioner'. Advanced practitioners seem to be to GPs what pcso's are to real police officers, and I have been repeatedly dealt with by receptionists who imagine they are triage nurses.

The IT system at the practice seems to malfunction regularly and it is impossible to email them or supply them with any kind of electronic document. I have been told that this is because this exposes the IT system to viruses but my friend's large GP practice seem to have no problem receiving emails and attached documents.

This deterioration has coincided with the practice expanding to run two further practices, one at Salford University, the other at Salford Quays. Given that the core medical staff are substantially unchanged since the time when I first enrolled at the practice my suspicion is that Langworthy Medical Practice is suffering from the deleterious effects of this over-expansion.

I have previously recommended this practice to friends and neighbours. I would now tell anyone thinking of enrolling as a patient at Langworthy Medical Practice to avoid the place.",null,[0,233]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/889910216783181646/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnhPV1pxWjFCbkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/889910216783181646/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnhPV1pxWjFCbkVBRRAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/889910216783181646/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnhPV1pxWjFCbkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/889910216783181646/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnhPV1pxWjFCbkVBRRAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/889910216783181646/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnhPV1pxWjFCbkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/889910216783181646/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnhPV1pxWjFCbkVBRRAA"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNxOWZqZ1BnEAE!2m1!1s0x0:0x174d58fdfde2e035!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgICq9fjgPg%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNxOWZqZ1BnEAE&t=1&entityid=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNxOWZqZ1BnEi0KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJQ3E5ZmpndmdFEhJDZ3NJMnNtZGhnWVE4SzdrTWcaLAoWQ0lITTBvZ0tFSUNBZ0lDcTlmamdmZxISQ2dzSTJzbWRoZ1lROEs3a01nIhIJAAAAAAAAAAARNeDi_f1YTRcqEkNnc0kyc21kaGdZUThLN2tNZw&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjLx9Cwwa6TAxUmH3sEHTocFbEQoykIBygB"],null,[null,[[1,8]]]],"0ahUKEwjLx9Cwwa6TAxUmH3sEHTocFbEQ0pMFCAUoAQ"],null,"CAESZENBRVExZ0lhUkVOcVJVbEJVa2x3UTJkdlFWQTNNa2xZTVVobmQwWmZYMFZvUWkwdGQxSnNWM1EwYW1ad2RWYzBaekJCUVVGQlFVZG5iamt6T0RSRGFHWlZaVVJCVlZsQlEwbEI="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURNemRIS0ZREAE",["0x0:0x174d58fdfde2e035",null,1578437871548837,1623262329527818,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106190368786139985894/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Alex
